texts.92.791: Elead, el´-e-ad, whom God praises. 1 Chr. 7. 21.
texts.92.792: Elealeh, el-e-a´-lay, whither God ascends. Num. 32. 3.
texts.92.793: Eleasah, el-e´-a-sah, whom God made or created. 1 Chr. 2. 39.
texts.92.794: Eleazar, el-e-a´-zar, whom God aids. Ex. 6. 23.
texts.92.795: El-elohe-Israel, el-el-o´-he-iz´-ra-el, God, the God of Israel. Gen. 33. 20.
texts.92.797: Elhanan, el-ha´-nan, whom God gave. 2 Sam. 21. 19.
texts.92.799: Eli, e´-li, going up, height, summit. 1 Sam. 1. 3.
texts.92.800: Eliab, el-i´-ab, whose father is God. Num. 1. 9.
texts.92.801: Eliada, or Eliadah, el´-i-a-dah, whom God cares for. 2 Sam. 5.16. 1 Kin. 11. 23.
texts.92.802: Eliah, el-i´-ah, my God is Jehovah. 1 Chr. 8. 27.
texts.92.803: Eliahba, el-i´-a-bah, whom God hides. 2 Sam. 23. 32.
texts.92.804: Eliakim, el-i´-a-kim, whom God has set. 2 Kin. 18. 18. 2 Kin. 23. 34.
texts.92.807: Eliasaph, el-i´-a-saf, whom God added. Num. 1. 14.
texts.92.808: Eliathah, el-i´-a-thah, to whom God comes. 1 Chr. 25. 4.
texts.92.809: Elidad, el-i´-dad, whom God loves. Num. 34. 21.
texts.92.810: Eliel, el-i´-el, to whom God (gives) strength. 1 Chr. 5. 24.
texts.92.811: Elienai, el-i-e´-fiai, unto Jehovah my eyes (are turned). 1 Chr. 8. 20.
texts.92.812: Eliezee, el-i-e´-zer, to whom God is help. Gen. 15. 2.
texts.92.813: Elihoreph, el-i-ho´-ref, to whom God is the reward. 1 Kin. 4. 3.
texts.92.814: Elihu, el-i´-hu, whose God is He. 1 Sam. 1. 1.
texts.92.815: Elijah, el-i´-jah, my God is Jehovah. 1 Kin. 17. 1.
texts.92.816: Elika, el-i´-kah, God of the congregation (?). 2 Sam. 23. 25.
texts.92.818: Elimelech, el-im´-e-lek, to whom God is king. Ruth 1. 2.
texts.92.819: Elioesai, el-i-o-e´-nai, unto Jehovah my eyes (are turned). 1 Chr. 3. 23.
texts.92.820: Eliphal, el´-i-fal, whom God judges. 1 Chr. 11. 35.
texts.92.821: Eliphalet, el-if-a-let, Eliphelet, el-i´-fel-et,) or to whom God is salvation. 2 Sam. 5. 16; 1 Chr. 3. 8. 2 Sam. 23. 34.
texts.92.822: Eliphaz, el´-i-faz, to whom God is strength. Gen. 36. 4.
texts.92.823: Elipheleh, el-if´-a-leh, whom God distinguishes (i.e., makes distinguished). 1 Chr. 15. 18.
texts.92.824: Elisabeth, el-iz´-a-beth, the oath of God. Luke 1. 5.
texts.92.825: Eliseus, e-li-se´-us (Greek form of Elisha) Ecclus. 48. 12. Luke 4. 27.
texts.92.826: Elisha, el-i´-sha, to whom God is salvation. 1 Kin. 19.16.
texts.92.828: Elishama, e-lish´-a-ma, whom God hears. Num. 1. 10.
texts.92.829: Elishaphat, e-lish´-a-fat, whom God judges. 2 Chr. 23. 1.
texts.92.830: Elisheba, el-i´-she-ba, to whom God is the oath. Ex. 6. 23.
texts.92.831: Elishua, e-lish´-u-ah, to whom God is salvation. 2 Sam. 5. 15.
texts.92.832: Eliud, el-i´-ud, God of Judah. Mat. 1. 14.
texts.92.833: EIizaphan, e-liz´-a-fan, whom God protects. Num. 3. 30.
texts.92.834: Elizur, el-i´-zur, to whom God is a rock. Num. 1. 5.
texts.92.835: Elkanah, el´-ka-nah, whom God created or possessed. Ex. 6. 24.
texts.92.836: Elkoshite, el´-ko-shite, inhabitant of Elkosh. Nah. 1. 1.
texts.92.837: Ellasar, el´-la-sar, oak or heap of Assyria. Gen. 14. 1.
texts.92.839: Elnaam, el´-na-am, whose pleasure or joy God is. 1 Chr. 11. 46.
texts.92.840: Elnathan, el-na´-than, whom God gave. 2 Kin. 24. 8.
texts.92.843: Elonites, e´-lon-ites, descendants of Elon. Num. 26. 26.
texts.92.844: Elon-beth-hanan, e´-lon-beth´-ha-nan, oak of the house of grace. 1 Kin. 4. 9.
texts.92.846: Elpaal, el´-pa-al, to whom God is the reward. 1 Chr. 8. 11.
texts.92.847: Elpalet, el´-pa-let, to whom God is salvation. 1 Chr. 14. 5.
texts.92.848: El-paran, el´-pa-ran, oak of Paran. Gen. 14. 6.
texts.92.849: Eltekeh, el´-te-keh, to which God is fear (or object of fear). Josh. 19. 44.
texts.92.850: Eltekon, el´-te-kon, to which God is the foundation. Josh. 15. 59.
texts.92.851: Eltolad, el´-to-lad, whose race or posterity is from God. Josh. 15. 30.
texts.92.852: Eluzai, e-lu´-zai, God is my praises (i.e., my praises are directed to God). 1 Chr. 12. 5.
texts.92.853: Elymas, el´-y-mas, a corrupter, or sorcerer. Acts 13. 8.
texts.92.854: Elzabad, el´-za-bad, whom God gave. 1 Chr. 12. 12.
texts.92.855: Elzaphan, el´-za-fan, whom God protects. Ex. 6. 22.
texts.92.857: Emmanuel, em-man´-u-el, God with us. Mat. 1. 23.
texts.92.862: En-dor, en´-dor, fountain of habitation. Josh. 17. 11.
texts.92.863: En-eglaim, en-eg-la´-im, f. of two calves, or two pools. Ezek. 47. 10.
texts.92.864: En-gannim, en-san´-nim, f. of gardens. Josh. 15. 34. Josh. 19. 21.
texts.92.865: En-gepi, en´-ge-di, f. of the kid. Josh. 15. 62.
texts.92.866: En-haddah, en-had´-dah, f. of sharpness (i. e., swift f.). Josh. 19. 21.
texts.92.867: En-hakkore, en-hak-ko´-ree, f. of the crier. Judg. 15. 19.
texts.92.868: En-hazor, en-ha´-zor, f. of the village. Josh. 19. 37.
texts.92.869: En-mishpat, en-mish´-pat, f. of judgment. Gen. 14. 7.
texts.92.870: Enoch, e´-nok, initiated, or initiating. Gen. 4. 17.
texts.92.872: En-rimmon, en-rim´-mon, fountain of the pomegranate. Neh. 11. 29.
texts.92.873: En-rogel, en-ro´-gei, f. of the spy, or fuller´s f. Josh. 15. 7.
texts.92.874: En-shemesh, en-she´-mesh, f. of the sun. Josh. 15. 7.
texts.92.875: En-tappuah, en-tap´-pu-ah, f. of the apple tree. Josh. 17. 7.
texts.92.876: Epaphras, ep´-a-fras (contracted from the next word). Col. 1. 7.
texts.92.880: Ephai, e´-fai, wearied out, languishing. Jer. 40. 8.
texts.92.881: Epher, e´-fer, calf, young animal. Gen. 25. 4.
texts.92.882: Ephes-dammim, e´-fez-dam´-mim, cessation of blood. 1 Sam. 17. 1.
texts.92.884: Ephesians, ef-fe´-zhi-ans, inhabitants of Ephesus. Acts 19. 28.
texts.92.886: Ephod, e´-fod, to gird on, put on. Num. 34. 23.
texts.92.887: Ephraim, e´-fra-im, double land, twin land. Gen. 41. 52. 2 Sam. 13. 23. John 11. 54.
texts.92.888: Ephraimites, e´-fra-im-ites, inhabitants of Ephraim. Judg. 12. 4.
texts.92.889: Ephratah, ei´-ra-tah, land, region (?), or fruitful (?). 1 Chr. 2. 50. Ruth 4. 11.
texts.92.890: Ephrathites, ef´-rath-ites, inhabitants of Ephrath. Ruth 1. 2.
texts.92.891: Ephron, ef´-ron, of or belonging to a calf. Gen. 23. 8. Josh. 15. 9.
texts.92.892: Epicureans, ep-i-ku-re´-ans, followers of Epicurus. Acts 17. 18.
texts.92.893: Er, err, or Eran, e´-ran, watcher, watchful. Gen. 38. 3. Num. 26. 36.
texts.92.894: Eranites, e´-ran-ites, posterity of Eran. Num. 26. 36.
texts.92.897: Eri, e´-ri, guarding (i.e., worshipping) Jehovah. Gen. 46. 16.
texts.92.898: Erites, e´-rites, inhabitants of Eri. Num. 26. 16.
texts.92.899: Esar-haddon, e´-sar-had´-don, gift of fire. 2 Kin. 19. 37.
texts.92.903: Esh-baal, esh´-ba-al, man or fire of Baal. 1 Chr. 8. 33.
texts.92.909: Eshtemoa, esh-tem-o´-ah, or Eshtemoh, esh´-te-moh, obedience. 1 Chr. 4. 19. Josh. 21. 14; 15. 50.
texts.92.911: Esli, es´-li, whom Jehovah reserved (?). Luke 3. 25.
texts.92.912: Esora, e-so´-ra (probably Hazor or Zorah). Judith 4. 4.
texts.92.914: Esther, es´-ter, star, fortune, felicity. Est. 2. 7.
texts.92.915: Etam, e´-tam, a place of ravenous creatures. Judg. 15. 8.
texts.92.916: Etham, e´-tham, boundary of the sea (?). Ex. 13. 20.
texts.92.917: Ethan, e´-than, a wise man, firmness. 1 Kin. 4. 31.
texts.92.918: Ethbaal, eth-ba´-al, living with Baal (i. e., enjoying the favour and help of Baal). 1 Kin. 16. 31.
texts.92.920: Ethiopia, e-thi-o´-pi-ah, (region of) burnt faces. Gen. 2. 13.
texts.92.923: Eubulus, eu-bu´-lus, prudent, wise, good counsellor. 2 Tim. 4. 21.
texts.92.931: Evil-merodach, e´-vil-mer´-o-dak, the fool or worshipper of Merodach. 2 Kin. 25. 27.
texts.92.937: Ezekiel, ez-e´-ki-el, whom God will strengthen. Ezek. 1. 3.
texts.92.941: Ezion-geber, e´-zi-on-ge´-ber, the backbone of a giant. Num. 33. 35.
texts.92.944: Ezrahite, ez´-ra-hite, a descendant of Ezra, or Zerah. 1 Kin. 4. 31.
texts.92.945: Ezri, ez´-ri, ready to help, the help of Jehovah. 1 Chr. 27. 26.
texts.92.955: Gabbai, gab´-bai, an exactor of tribute. Neh. 11. 8.
texts.92.957: Gabriel, ga´-bri-el, man of God. Dan. 8. 16. Luke 1. 19.
texts.92.958: Gad, gad, a troop, good fortune. Gen. 30. 11. 1 Sam. 22. 5.
texts.92.960: Gadarenes, gad-a-reens´, inhabitants of Gadara. Mark 5. 1.
texts.92.962: Gaddiel, gad´-di-el, fortune of God (i.e., sent from God). Num. 13. 10.
texts.92.963: Gadites, gad´-ites, descendants of Gad. Deu. 3. 12.
texts.92.969: Galatians, ga-la´-shyans, inhabitants of Galatia. Gal. 3. 1.
texts.92.973: Gallio, galMi-o, one who lives on milk. Acts 18. 12.
texts.92.974: Gamaliel, ga-ma´-li-el, benefit of God. Num. 1. 10. Acts 5. 34.
texts.92.980: Gatam, ga´-tam, their touch, one puny or thin. Gen. 36. 11.
texts.92.982: Gath-hepher, gath-he´-fer, the wine-press of the well. Josh. 19. 13. 2 Kin. 14. 25.
texts.92.983: Gath-rimmox, gath-rim´-mon, wine-press of the pomegranate. Josh. 19. 45.
texts.92.985: Gazer, ga´-zer, place cut off, precipice. 2 Sam. 5. 25.
texts.92.987: Gazites, ga´-zites, inhabitants of Gaza. Judg. 16.2.
texts.92.992: Gebim, ge´-bim, (1) cisterns, or locusts, (2) trenches. Is. 10. 31.
texts.92.993: Gedaliah, ged-a-li´-ah, whom Jehovah has made great. 2 Kin. 25. 22.
texts.92.994: Geder, ge´-der or Gedor, ge´-dor, wall. Josh. 12. 13. 1 Chr. 4. 4. Josh. 15. 58.
texts.92.996: Gederite, ged-e´-rite, native of Geder. 1 Chr. 27. 28.
texts.92.999: Gehazi, ge-ha´-zi, valley of vision. 2 Kin. 4. 12.
texts.92.1001: Gemalli, ge-mal´-li, possessor or driver of camels. Num. 13. 12.
texts.92.1002: Gemariah, gem-a-ri´-ah, whom Jehovah has completed. Jer. 29. 3. Jer. 36. 10.
texts.92.1006: Gentiles. jen´-tiles, the nations of the west Gen. 10. 5.
texts.92.1007: Gera or Gerah, ge´-ra, a grain. Gen. 46. 21. Ex. 30. 13
texts.92.1009: Gergesenes, ger-ge-seens´, inhabitants of Gerasa. Mat. 8. 28.
texts.92.1011: Gershom, ger´-shom or Gershon, ger´-shon, expulsion. Ex. 2. 22. Gen. 46. 11.
texts.92.1013: Geshem, ge´-shem, is rained upon. Neh. 2. 19.
texts.92.1015: Geshuri, ge-shu´-ri or Geshurites, ge-shu´-rites, inhabitants of Geshur. Deu. 3. 14. Josh. 12. 5.
texts.92.1018: Geuel, gew´-el, majesty of Gocl. Num. 13. 15.
texts.92.1019: Gezer, ge´-zer, place cut off, precipice. Josh. 10. 33.
texts.92.1020: Gezrites, gez´-rites, dwelling in a desert land. 1 Sam. 27. 8.
texts.92.1021: Giah, gi´-ah, breaking forth (of a fountain). 2 Sam. 2. 24.
texts.92.1022: Gibbar, gib´-bar, a hero, a soldier. Ezra 2. 20.
texts.92.1023: Gibbethon, gih´-be-thon, a lofty place, an acclivity. Josh. 19. 44.
texts.92.1024: Gibea or Gibeah, gib´-e-ah, hill. 1 Chr. 2. 49. Josh. 15. 57. Josh. 18. 28.
texts.92.1025: Gibeon, gib´-e-on, pertaining to a hill (i. e., built on a hill). Josh. 9. 3.
texts.92.1026: Gibeonites, gib´-e-on-ites, inhabitants of Gibeon. 2 Sam. 21. 1.
texts.92.1027: Giblites, gib´-lites, inhabitants of Gebal. Josh. 13. 5.
texts.92.1028: Giddalti, gid-dal´-ti, I have trained up. 1 Chr. 25. 4.
texts.92.1029: Giddel, gid´-del, too great, giant. Ezra 2. 47.
texts.92.1030: Gideon, gid´-e-on, cutter down (i.e., brave soldier). Judg. 6. 11.
texts.92.1031: Gideoni, gid-e-o´-ni, Gidom, gi´-dom, cutting down. Num. 1. 11. Judg. 20. 45.
texts.92.1032: Gihon, gi´-hon, breaking forth (of a river). Gen. 2. 13.
texts.92.1035: Gilead, gil´-e-ad, (1) hard, stony region, (2) hill of witness. Gen. 31. 21.
texts.92.1036: Gileadite, gil´-e-ad-ite, inhabitant of Gilead. Judg. 10. 3.
texts.92.1037: Gilgal, gil´-gal, a circle, or a rolling away. Josh. 4. 19.
texts.92.1039: Gimzo, sim´-zo, a place abounding with sycamores. 2 Chr. 28. 18.
texts.92.1043: Girgashite, gir´-gash-ite, dwelling in a clayey soil. 1 Chr. 1. 14.
texts.92.1045: Gittah-hepher, git´-tah-he´-fer, wine-press of the well. Josh. 19. 13.
texts.92.1047: Gittites, git´-tites, inhabitants of Gath. Josh. 13. 3.
texts.92.1048: Gittith, git´-tith, a stringed instrument. Ps. 8, title.
texts.92.1055: Goliath, go-li´-ath, exile, an exile. 1 Sam. 17. 4.
texts.92.1059: Goyim, go´-yeem (or Gutium), "nations" Gen. 14. 1. A barbarous district, afterwards forming the basis of the kingdom of Assyria.
texts.92.1061: Greece, grees or Grecia, greesh´-ya, country of the Greeks. Acts 20. 2. Dan. 8. 21.
texts.92.1063: Guni, gu´-ni, painted with colours. Gen. 46. 24.
texts.92.1064: Gunites, gu´-nites, descendants of Guni. Num. 26. 48. 1 Chr. 5. 15.
texts.92.1065: Gur, gur, whelp, lion´s cub. 2 Kin. 9. 27.
texts.92.1066: Gur-baal, gur-ba´-al, sojourning of Baal. 2 Chr. 26. 7.
texts.92.1069: Habaiah, ha-bai´-ah, whom Jehovah hides. Ezra 2. 61.
texts.92.1071: Habaziniah, hab-az-i-ni´-ah, lamp of Jehovah. Jer. 35. 3.
texts.92.1073: Hachaliah, hak-a-li´-ah, whom Jehovah disturbs, dark. Neh. 1. 1.
texts.92.1076: Hachmonite, hak´-mo-nite, a descendant of Hachmoni. 1 Chr. 11. 11.
texts.92.1078: Hadadezer, had-ad-e´-zer, whose help is Hadad. 2 Sam. 8. 3.
texts.92.1079: Hadadrimmon, ha´-dad-rim´-mon (named from Hadad and Rimmon, q.v.). Zech. 12. 11.
texts.92.1086: Hadlai, had´-lai, rest, rest of God. 2 Chr. 28. 12.
texts.92.1089: Hagab, ha´-gab or Hagaba, ha-ga´-bah, locust. Ezra 2. 46. Neh. 7. 48.
texts.92.1093: Haggiah, hag-gi´-ah, festival of Jehovah. 1 Chr. 6. 30.
texts.92.1094: Haggites, hag´-gites, the posterity of Haggi. Num. 26. 15.
texts.92.1095: Haggith, hag´-gith, festive, a dancer. 2 Sam. 3. 4.
texts.92.1096: Hai, ha´-i, a heap of ruins. Gen. 12. 8.
texts.92.1104: Hallelujah, hal-le-ioo´-yah, praise ye Jehovah. (See Alleluia.)
texts.92.1106: Ham, ham, (1) warm, black. Gen. 9. 18; (2) noisy, multitude. Gen. 14. 5.
texts.92.1109: Hamathite, ha´-math-ite, a dweller at Hamath. Gen. 10. 18.
texts.92.1110: Hamath-zobah, ha´-math-zo´-bah, fortress of Zobah. 2 Chr. 8. 3.
texts.92.1115: Hammon, ham´-mon, warm or sunny. Josh. 19. 28.
texts.92.1118: Hamon-gog, ha´-mon-gog, m. of Gog. Ezek. 39.11.
texts.92.1120: Hamuel, ha´-mu-el, heat (wrath) of God. 1 Chr. 4. 26.
texts.92.1121: Hamul, ha´-mul, who has experienced mercy. Gen. 46.12.
texts.92.1122: Hamulites, ha´-mul-ites, the posterity of Hamul. Num. 26. 21.
texts.92.1123: Hamutal, ha-mu´-tal, refreshing like dew. 2 Kin. 23. 31.
texts.92.1124: Hanameel, han´-a-me-el, or Hananeel, han´-a-ne-el, whom God graciously gave. Jer. 32. 7. Neh. 3. 1.
texts.92.1127: Hananiah, han-a-ni´-ah, whom Jehovah graciously gave. 1 Chr. 3.19.
texts.92.1129: Haniel, han´-i-el, grace of God. 1 Chr. 7. 39.
texts.92.1132: Hanniel, han´-ni-el, the favour of God. Num. 34. 23.
texts.92.1134: Hanochites, ha´-nok-ites, descendants of Hanoch. Num. 26. 5.
texts.92.1135: Hanun, ha´-nun, gracious, whom (God) pities. 2 Sam. 10. 1.
texts.92.1139: Haran, ha´-ran, (1) mountaineer. Gen. 11. 27; (2) parched, dry. 1 Chr. 2. 46. Gen. 11. 31.
texts.92.1144: Harhaiah, har-hai´-yah, who was dried up. Neh. 3. 8.
texts.92.1149: Harnepher, har-ne´-fer, to snore, to inhale, to pant. 1 Chr. 7. 36.
texts.92.1151: Harodite, har´-ro-dite, inhabitant of Harod. 2 Sam. 23. 25.
texts.92.1154: Harosheth, har-o´-sheth, carving or working. Judg. 4. 2.
texts.92.1160: Hasadiah, has-a-di´-ah, whom Jehovah loves. 1 Chr. 3. 20.
texts.92.1162: Hashabiah, hash-a-bi´-ah, Hashabnah, bash-ab´-nah, or Hashabniah, hash-ab-ni´-ah, whom Jehovah esteems. 1 Chr. 6. 45. Neh. 10. 25. Neh. 3. 10.
texts.92.1163: Hashbadana, hash-bad-a´-na, thought in judging, wise judge. Neh. 8. 4.
texts.92.1165: Hashmonah, hash-mo´-nah, fatness, fat soil. Num. 33. 29.
texts.92.1166: Hashub, ha´-shub, or Hashubah, ha-shu´-bah, understanding, considerate. Neh. 3. 11. 1 Chr. 3. 20.
texts.92.1171: Hasupha, has-u´-fah, one of the Nethinims. Ezra 2. 43.
texts.92.1180: Havoth-jair, ha´-voth-ja´-ir, villages of Jair. Num. 32. 41.
texts.92.1181: Hazael, haz´-a-el, whom God watches over. 1 Kin. 19.15.
texts.92.1182: Hazaiah, haz-ai´-ah, whom Jehovah watches over. Neh. 11. 5.
texts.92.1183: Hazar-addar, ha´-zar-ad´-dar, village of Addar. Num. 34. 4.
texts.92.1184: Hazar-enan, ha´-zar-e´-nan, v. of fountains. Num. 34. 9.
texts.92.1185: Hazau-gaddatt, ha´-zar-gad´-dah, v. of good fortune. Josh. 15. 27.
texts.92.1187: Hazaumaveth, ha´-zar-ma´-veth, court of death. Gen. 10. 26.
texts.92.1188: Hazar-shual, ha´-zar-shu´-al, village of jackals. Josh. 15. 28.
texts.92.1189: Hazar-susah, ha´-zar-su´-sah, or Hazar-susch, ha´-zar-su´-sim, v. of (station for) horses. Josh. 19. 5. 1 Chr. 4. 31.
texts.92.1190: Hazelelponi, ha´-zel-el-po´-ni, the shadow looking on me. 1 Chr. 4. 3.
texts.92.1191: Hazerim, haz-e´-rim, or Hazeroth, haz-e´-roth, villages. Deu. 2. 23. Num. 11. 35.
texts.92.1192: Hazezon-tamar, ha´-ze-zon-ta´-mar, pruning of the palm. Gen. 14. 7.
texts.92.1193: Haziel, ha´-zi-el, the vision of God, seen by God. 1 Chr. 23. 9.
texts.92.1196: Heber, he´-ber, (1) a passer over. 1 Chr. 5. 13; (2) fellowship, society. Gen. 46.17. Judg. 4. 11.
texts.92.1197: Hebrews, he´-brews, descendants of Eber. Gen. 40. 15.
texts.92.1198: Hebron, he´-bron, conjunction, joining, alliance. Ex. 6. 18. Gen. 13. 18.
texts.92.1199: Hebronites, he´-bron-ites, the people of Hebron. Num. 3. 27.
texts.92.1203: Helbah, hel´-bah, fatness (i.e., a fertile region). Judg. 1. 31.
texts.92.1205: Heldai, hel´-dai, worldly, terrestrial, vital. 1 Chr. 27.15.
texts.92.1207: Heled, he´-led, life, the world. 1 Chr. 11. 30.
texts.92.1209: Helekites, he´-lek-ites, descendants of Helek. Num. 26. 30.
texts.92.1214: Helkai, hel´-kai, Jehovah his portion. Neh. 12. 15.

texts.92.2530: Sheba, or Shebah, she´-bah. man, seven, or an oath. 2 Sam. 20. 1. Gen. 26. 33.
texts.92.2531: Shebam, she´-bam, coolness, sweet smell. Num. 32. 3.
texts.92.2532: Shebaniah, she-ba-ni´-ah, whom Jehovah made to grow up. 1 Chr. 15. 24.
texts.92.2535: Shebna, sheb´-nah, tender youth, youth. 2 Kin. 18. 18.
texts.92.2536: Shebuel, she-bu´-el, captive of God. 1 Chr. 23. 16.
texts.92.2537: Shechaniah, shek-a-ni´-ah, intimate with Jehovah, as if dwelling with Him. 1 Chr. 3. 21.
texts.92.2538: Shechem, she´-kem, back, shoulder-blade. Gen. 34. 2. Gen. 33. 18.
texts.92.2539: Shechemites, she´-kem-ites, people of Shechem. Num. 26. 31.
texts.92.2540: Shedeur, shed´-e-ur, casting forth of fire. Num. 1. 5.
texts.92.2541: Shehariak, she-ha-ri´-ah, whom Jehovah seeks for. 1 Chr. 8. 26.
texts.92.2543: Shelemiah, shel-e-mi´-ah, whom Jehovah repays. 1 Chr. 26. 14.
texts.92.2544: Sheleph, she´-lef, drawn out, saluted. Gen. 10. 26.
texts.92.2546: Shelomi, shel´-o-mi, or Shelomith, shei´-o-mith, peaceful, love of peace. Num. 34. 27. Lev. 24. 11.
texts.92.2547: Shelumiel, she-lu´-mi-el, friend of God. Num. 1. 6.
texts.92.2551: Shemaiah, shem-ai´-yah, whom Jehovah has heard and answered. 1 Kin. 12. 22.
texts.92.2552: Shemariah, shem-a-ri´-ah, whom Jehovah guards. 1 Chr. 12. 5.
texts.92.2553: Shemeber, shem-e´-ber, soaring on high. Gen. 14. 2.
texts.92.2555: Shemida, she´-mi-dah, fame of wisdom. Num. 26. 32.
texts.92.2557: Shemiramoth, she-mir´-a-moth, most high name, or most high heaven. 1 Chr. 15. 18.
texts.92.2558: Shemuel, shem´-u-el, heard of God, name of God. Num. 34. 20.
texts.92.2561: Shenir, she´-ner, coat of mail, cataract. Deu. 3. 9.
texts.92.2562: Shepham, she´-fam, nakedness, a place naked of trees. Num. 34. 10.
texts.92.2566: Shephuphan, she-fu´-fan, serpent, cerastes, or horned snake. 1 Chr. 8. 5.
texts.92.2568: Sherebiah, sher-e-bi´-ah, heat of Jehovah. Ezra 8. 18.
texts.92.2578: Shibmah, shib´-mah, coolness, or sweet smell. Num. 32. 38.
texts.92.2580: Shiggaion, shig-gai´-yon, or Shigionoth, shig-i´-o-noth, erratic, wandering. Ps. 7. title. Hab. 3. 1.
texts.92.2582: Shihor-libnath, shi´-hor-lib´-nath, black river of glass. Josh. 19. 26.
texts.92.2585: Shiloah, shi-lo´-ah, sending (of water by a conduit). Is. 8. 6.
texts.92.2586: Shiloh, shi´-lo, place of rest, pacificator. Josh. 18. 1.
texts.92.2587: Shiloni, shi-lo´-ni, or Shilonite, shi´-lo-nite, native of Shiloh. Neh. 11. 5. 1 Kin. 11. 29.
texts.92.2589: Shimea, shim´-e-ah, or Shimeah, shim´-e-ah, or Shimeam, shim´-e-am, rumour, fame. 1 Chr. 3. 5. 1 Chr. 8. 32. 1 Chr. 9. 38.
texts.92.2590: Shimeath, shim´-e-ath, or Shimei, shim´-e-i, rumour, famous, renowned. 2 Kin. 12. 21. Num. 3. 18.
texts.92.2598: Shimrom, shim´-rom, Shimron, shim´-ron, watch-post. 1 Chr. 7. 1. Gen. 46. 13. Josh. 11. 1.
texts.92.2599: Shimronites, shim´-ron-ites, descendants of Shimron. Num. 26. 24.
texts.92.2602: Shinar, shi´-nar, casting out (?), land of two rivers (?). Gen. 10. 10.
texts.92.2614: Shobai, sho´-bai, or Shobi, sho´-bi, who leads many captive. Ezra 2. 42. 2 Sam. 17. 27.
texts.92.2615: Shobal, sho´-bal, flowing, or a shoot. Gen. 36. 20.
texts.92.2618: Shoham, sho´-ham, onyx or sardonyx. 1 Chr. 24. 27.
texts.92.2628: Shumathites, shu´-ma-thites (derived from a word meaning garlic). 1 Chr. 2. 53.
texts.92.2629: Shunammite, shu´-nam-mite, an inhabitant of Shunem. 1 Kin. 1. 3.
texts.92.2636: Shuthelah, shu-the´-lah, crashing or rending. Num. 26. 35.
texts.92.2638: Sibbecai, or Sibbechai, sib´-be-kai, the wood of Jehovah (i.e., the crowd of the people of God). 2 Sam. 21. 18; 1 Chr. 11. 29.
texts.92.2640: Sibmah, sib´-mah, coolness, or sweet smell. Josh. 13. 19.
texts.92.2643: Siddim, sid´-dim, valley of the plains. Gen. 14. 3.
texts.92.2644: Sidon, si´-don, fishing, fishery. Gen. 10. 15. Mat. 11. 21.
texts.92.2646: Sihon, si´-hon, sweeping away (i.e., a leader, carrying all before him). Num. 21. 21.
texts.92.2647: Sihor, si´-hor, black, turbid. Josh. 13. 3. Is. 23. 3.
texts.92.2648: Silas, si´-las, the third, considering. Acts 15. 22.
texts.92.2651: Silvanus, sil-va´-nus, woody, or of the forest. 2 Cor. 1. 19.
texts.92.2652: Simeon, sim´-eon, hearing with acceptance. Gen. 29. 33. Luke 2. 25.
texts.92.2656: Sina, si´-na (Greek form of Sinai). Acts. 7. 30.
texts.92.2657: Sinai, si´-nai, the senna shrub. Ex. 19. 1, 18. Gal. 4. 24.
texts.92.2659: Sionn, si´-on, lifted up. Deu. 4. 48. Mat. 21. 5.
texts.92.2665: Sisera, sis´-e-ra, a field of battle. Judg. 4. 2.
texts.92.2669: So, so (Hebrew form of Egyptian word Sevech) 2 Kin. 17. 4.
texts.92.2670: Socho, or Sochoh, or Socoh, so´-ko, a hedge. 1 Chr. 4. 18. 1 Kin. 4. 10. Josh. 15. 35.
texts.92.2671: Sodi, so´-di, an acquaintance of God. Num. 13. 10.
texts.92.2677: Sosipater, so-sip´-a-ter, saving the father. Rom. 16. 21.
texts.92.2680: Spain, spane (Greek), rare or precious. Rom. 15. 24, 28.
texts.92.2681: Stachys, sta´-kis, an ear of corn. Rom. 16. 9.
texts.92.2682: Stephanas, stef´-a-nas, or Stephen, ste´-ven, crown or crowns. 1 Cor. 1. 16. Acts 6. 5; 7. 59.
texts.92.2685: Succoth-benoth, suk´-koth-be´-noth, booths of daughters. 2 Kin. 17. 30.
texts.92.2687: Sukkiims, suk´-ki-ims, dwellers in tents. 2 Chr. 12. 3.
texts.92.2689: Susanchites, su´-san-kites, inhabitants of Susa or Shushan. Ezra 4. 9.
texts.92.2690: Susanna, su-san´-nah, lily, rose, or joy. Luke 8. 3.
texts.92.2693: Sychem, si´-kem (Greek form of Shechem). Acts 7. 16.
texts.92.2694: Syene, si-e´-ne, opening, key (i.e., of Egypt). Ezek. 29. 10.
texts.92.2698: Syrian, sir´-i-an, inhabitant of Syria. Gen. 25. 20.
texts.92.2699: Syrophenician, si´-ro-fee-nish´-yan, Phenician living in Syria. Mark 7. 26.
texts.92.2702: Taanath-shiloh, ta´-a-nath-shi´-lo, approach to Shiloh. Josh. 16. 6.
texts.92.2705: Tabeal, tab´-e-al, or Tabeel, tab´-e-el, the goodness of God. or, God is good. Is. 7. 6. Ezra 4. 7.
texts.92.2708: Tabor, ta´-bor, a lofty place, mound. Josh. 19. 22; Judg. 4. 6.
texts.92.2709: Tabrimon, tab´-ri-mon, who pleases Rimmon, for Rimnion is good. 1 Kin. 15. 18.
texts.92.2711: Tadmor, tad´-mor, city of palms. 1 Kin. 9. 18.
texts.92.2712: Tahan, ta´-han, a camp, a station. Num. 26. 25.
texts.92.2713: Tahanites, ta´-han-ites, descendants of Tahan. Num. 26. 35.
texts.92.2714: Tahapanes, ta-hap´-pa-nes, or Tahpenes, tah´-pen-es, head of the age or world. Jer. 2. 16. 1 Kin. 11. 19.
texts.92.2717: Tahtim-hodshi, tah´-tim-hod´-shi, nether land newly inhabited. 2 Sam. 24. 6.
texts.92.2718: Talmai, tal-ma´-i, abounding in furrows. Num. 13. 22. 2 Sam. 3. 3.
texts.92.2721: Tamar, ta´-mar, a palm tree. Gen. 38. 6. Ezek. 47. 19.
texts.92.2726: Tappuah, tap-pu´-ah, a place fruitful in apples. 1 Chr. 2. 43. Josh. 15. 34.
texts.92.2730: Tarpelites, tar´-pe-lites, people of Tarpel (in Assyria?). Ezra 4. 9.
texts.92.2731: Tarshish, tar´-shish, hard ground (?). Gen. 10. 4. Jonah 1. 3.
texts.92.2732: Tarsus, tar´-sus (probably same as Tarshish). Acts 9. 11.
texts.92.2733: Tartar, tar´-tak, profound darkness, or hero of darkness. 2 Kin. 17. 31.
texts.92.2737: Tebaliah, teb-a-li´-ah, one whom Jehovah has immersed (i.e., purified). 1 Chr. 26. 11.
texts.92.2739: Tebinnah, te-hin´-nah, cry for mercy. 1 Chr. 4. 12.
texts.92.2741: Tekoa, te-ko´-a, or Tekoah, te-ko´-ah, pitching of tents. 1 Chr. 2. 24. 2 Sam. 14. 2.
texts.92.2742: Tekoites, te-ko´-ites, inhabitants of Tekoah. 2 Sam. 23. 26.
texts.92.2743: Tel-abib, tel-a´-bib, hill of ears of corn. Ezek. 3. 15.
texts.92.2746: Telassar, te-las´-sar, hill of Ashur (?). Is. 37. 12.
texts.92.2748: Tel-haresha, tel-har´-e-sha, or Tel-harsa, tel-har´-sah, hill of the wood. Neh. 7. 61; Ezra 2. 59.
texts.92.2749: Tel-melati, tel-me´-lah, hill of salt. Ezra 2. 59.
texts.92.2750: Tema, te´-mah, Teman, te´-man, a desert, south. Gen. 25. 15. Gen. 36. 11.
texts.92.2751: Temani, tem´-a-ni, Temanite, tern´-a-nite, descendants of Teman. Gen. 36. 34. Job 2. 11.
texts.92.2758: Thahash, tha´-hash, badger, or seal. Gen. 22. 24.
texts.92.2763: Theophilus, the-off-i-lus, lover of God. Luke 1. 3.
texts.92.2767: Thomas, tom´-as, a twin, sound. Mat. 10. 3.
texts.92.2771: Tiberius, ti-be´-ri-us, son of the river Tiber. Luke 3. 1.
texts.92.2773: Tibni, tib´-ni, building of Jehovah. 1 Kin. 16. 21.
texts.92.2775: Tiglath-pileser, tig´-lath-pi-le´-zer, or Tilgath-pilesner, til´-gath-pil-ne´-zer, lord of the Tigris. 2 Kin. 15. 29; 1 Chr. 5. 6.
texts.92.2776: Tikvah, tik´-vah, or Tikvath, tik´-vath, expectation. 2 Kin. 22. 14; 2 Chr. 34. 22.
texts.92.2779: Timna, tim´-na, or Timnah, tim´-nah, or Timnath, tim´-nath, restraint, restrained. Gen. 36. 12. Josh. 15.10. Gen. 38. 12.
texts.92.2780: Timnath-heres, tim´-nath-he´-res, portion of the sun. Judg. 2. 9.
texts.92.2783: Timotheus, ti-mo´-the-us, or Timothy, tim´-o-thy, honour of God. Acts 16. 1; 2 Cor. 1. 1.
texts.92.2791: Tishbite, tish´-bite, inhabitant of Tishbe. 1 Kin. 17. 1.
texts.92.2792: Tisri, or Tizri, tiz´-ri, expiation (?), beginning (?). (Ethanim. 1 Kin. 8. 2.
texts.92.2796: Tob-adonijah, tob-ad-o-ni´-jah, good is my lord Jehovah. 2 Chr. 17. 8.
texts.92.2797: Tobiah, to-bi´-ah, Tobijah, to-bi´-jah, pleasing to Jehovah. Ezra 2. 60. 2 Chr. 17. 8.
texts.92.2801: Toi, to´-i, Tou, to´u, error. 2 Sam. 8. 9. 1 Chr. 18. 9.
texts.92.2803: Tolad, to´-lad, race, posterity, birth. 1 Chr. 4. 29.
texts.92.2811: Tryphosa, tri-fo´-sah, thrice shining, living delicately. Rom. 16. 12.
texts.92.2813: Tubal-cain, tu´-bal-kane, worker in ore. Gen. 4. 22.
texts.92.2818: Ucal, u´-kal, I shall prevail. Prov. 30. 1.
texts.92.2819: Uel, u´-el, will of God. Ezra 10. 34.
texts.92.2828: Urbane, ur´-ban, civil, courteous, gentle in speech. Rom. 16. 9.
texts.92.2830: Uriah, u-ri´-ah, or Urijah, u-ri´-jah, flame of Jehovah. 2 Sam. 11. 3. 2 Kin. 16. 10.
texts.92.2832: Uriel, u'-ri-el, flame of God. 1 Cor. 6. 24.
texts.92.2834: Uthai, u´-thai, whom Jehovah succours. 1 Chr. 9. 4.
texts.92.2835: Uz, uz, soft and sandy earth (?), fertile land (?). Gen. 10. 23. Job 1. 1.
texts.92.2838: Uzza, or Uzzah, uz´-zah, strength. 2 Kin. 21. 18. 2 Sam. 6. 3.
texts.92.2839: Uzzen-sheeah, uz´-zen-she´-rah, ear (or rather corner) of Sherah. 1 Chr. 7. 24.
texts.92.2840: Uzzi, uz´-zi, might of Jehovah. 1 Chr. 6. 5.
texts.92.2842: Uzziel, uz´-zi-el, power of God. Ex. 6. 18.
texts.92.2843: Uzzielites, uz´-zi-el-ites, descendants of Uzziel. Num. 3. 27.
texts.92.2847: Vashni, vash´-ni, (uncertain; probably not a proper name). 1 Chr. 6. 28.
texts.92.2851: Zaanaim, za-a-na´-im, or Zaanannim, za-a-nan´-nim, removings. Judg. 4. 11. Josh. 19. 33.
texts.92.2852: Zaanan, za-a´-nan, place of flocks. Mic. 1. 11.
texts.92.2856: Zabbud, zab´-bud, given, a gift bestowed (i.e., by God). Ezra 8. 14.
texts.92.2857: Zabdi, zab´-di, the gift of Jehovah. Josh. 7. 1.
texts.92.2858: Zabdiel, zab´-di-el, the gift of God. 1 Chr. 27. 2.
texts.92.2861: Zaccai, zak-ka´-i, or Zaccheus, zak-ke´-us, pure, innocent. Ezra 2. 9. Luke 19. 2.
texts.92.2863: Zachariah, zak-a-ri´-ah or Zacharias, zak-a-ri´-as, whom Jehovah remembers. 2 Kin. 14. 29. Mat. 23. 35. Luke 1. 5.
texts.92.2871: Zalmunna, zal-mun´-nah, to whom shadow is denied. Judg. 8. 5.
texts.92.2872: Zamzummims, zam-zum´-mims, tribes making a noise. Deu. 2. 20.
texts.92.2874: Zaphnath-paaneah, zaf-nath-paa´-ne-ah, preserver of the age. Gen. 41. 45.
texts.92.2876: Zarah, za´-rah, a rising (of light). Gen. 38. 30.
texts.92.2878: Zareathites, za´-re-a-thites, inhabitants of Zareah. 1 Chr. 2. 53.
texts.92.2880: Zarephath, zar´-e-fath, workshop for melting and refining metals. 1 Kin. 17. 9.
texts.92.2881: Zaretan, zar´-e-tan, or Zartanah, zar´-ta-nah, cooling. Josh. 3. 18. 1 Kin. 4. 12.
texts.92.2882: Zareth-shahar, za´-reth-sha´-har, the splendour of the morning. Josh. 13. 19.
texts.92.2883: Zarhites, zar´-hites, descendants of Zerah. Num. 26. 13.
texts.92.2884: Zatthu, zat´-thu, a sprout. Neh. 10. 14. Ezra 2. 8.
texts.92.2887: Zebadiah, zeb-a-di´-ah, the gift of Jehovah. 1 Chr. 8. 15.
texts.92.2892: Zebul, ze´-bul, Zebulun, zeb´-u-lun, habitation. Judg. 9. 28. Gen. 30. 20. Judg. 5. 14.
texts.92.2893: Zechariah, zek-a-ri´-ah. whom Jehovah remembers. 2 Chr. 24. 20. 2 Chr. 26. 5. Zech. 1. 1.
texts.92.2894: Zedad, ze´-dad, a mountain, the side of a mountain. Num. 34. 8.
texts.92.2895: Zedekiah, zed-e-ki´-ah, justice of Jehovah. 1 Kin. 22. 11. 2 Kin. 24. 17.
texts.92.2897: Zelah, ze´-lah, a rib, the side. Josh. 18. 28.
texts.92.2899: Zelophehad, ze-lof-e-had, fracture, a first rupture, perhaps firstborn. Num. 26. 33.
texts.92.2900: Zelotes, ze-lo´-teez, jealous, or zealous. Luke 6. 15.
texts.92.2901: Zelzah, zel´-zah, shade in the heat of the sun. 1 Sam. 10. 2.
texts.92.2905: Zenan, ze-na´n, place of flocks. Josh. 15. 37.
texts.92.2907: Zephaniah, zef-a-ni´-ah, whom Jehovah hid (i.e., defended). 2 Kin. 25. 18. Zeph. 1. 1.
texts.92.2908: Zephath, ze´-fath, or Zephathah, ze´-fa-thah, or Zepho, ze´-fo, watch-tower. Judg. 1. 17. 2 Chr. 14. 10. Gen. 36. 11.
texts.92.2909: Zephon, ze´-fon, a looking out. Num. 29. 15.
texts.92.2910: Zephonites, ze´-fon-ites, descendants of Zephon. Num. 26. 15.
texts.92.2912: Zerah, ze´-rah, a rising (of light). 2 Chr. 14. 9.
texts.92.2913: Zerahiah, zer-a-hi´-ah, whom Jehovah caused to rise. 1 Chr. 6. 6.
texts.92.2915: Zereda, zer´-e-dah or Zeredathah, ze-red´-a-thah. cooling. 1 Kin. 11. 26 2 Chr. 4. 17.
texts.92.2918: Zeror, ze´-ror, bundle, or purse. 1 Sam. 9. 1.
texts.92.2920: Zerubbabel, ze-rub´-ba-bel, scattered to Babylon, or, born at Babylon. Hag. 1. 1.
texts.92.2923: Zethan, ze´-than or Zethar, ze´-thar, star. Est. 1. 10.
texts.92.2925: Ziba, zi´-bah, a plant, statue. 2 Sam. 9. 2.
texts.92.2926: Zibeon, zib´-e-on or Zibia, zib´-i-a or Zibiah, zib-i-ah, dyed, roe. Gen. 36. 2. 1 Chr. 8. 9. 2 Kin. 12. 1.
texts.92.2929: Zidkijah, zid-ki´-jah, justice of Jehovah. Neh. 10. 1.
texts.92.2931: Zidonians, zi-do´-ni-ans, inhabitants of Zidon. Judg. 10. 12.
texts.92.2937: Zinthai, zil´-thai, shadow (i.e., protection) of Jenovah. 1 Chr. 8. 20.
texts.92.2939: Zimran, zim´-ran or Zimri, zim´-ri, celebrated in song. Gen. 25. 2. 1 Kin. 16. 9.
texts.92.2940: Zin, zin, a low palm tree. Num. 13. 21.
texts.92.2942: Zion, zi´-on, a sunny plain, a sunny mountain, 2 Sam. 5. 7.
texts.92.2944: Ziph, zif, borrowed, flowing. 1 Chr. 4. 16. 1 Sam. 23. 14.
texts.92.2945: Ziphion, zif´-yon, expectation, looking out. Gen. 46. 16.
texts.92.2949: Zithri, zith´-ri, protection of Jehovah. Ex. 6. 22.
texts.92.2951: Ziza, or Zizah, zi´-zah, abundance. 1 Chr. 4. 37. 1 Chr. 23. 11.
texts.92.2952: Zoan, zo´-an, low region. Num. 13. 22. Ps. 78. 12.
texts.92.2954: Zoba, or Zobah, zo´-bah, a station. 2 Sam. 10. 6; 1 Sam. 14. 47.
texts.92.2957: Zoheleth, zo-he´-leth, serpent, stone of the serpent. 1 Kin. 1. 9.
texts.92.2963: Zorah, zo´-rah, a place of hornets. Josh. 19. 41.
texts.92.2964: Zorathites, zo´-ra-thites, people of Zorah. 1 Chr. 4. 2.
texts.92.2968: Zuph, zuf, flag, sedge. 1 Sam. 1. 1. 1 Sam. 9. 5.
texts.92.2969: Zur, zur, rock, shape, form. Num. 25. 15.
texts.92.2970: Zuriel, zu´-ri-el, whose rock is God. Num. 3. 35.
texts.92.2971: Zurishaddai, zu´-ri-shad-da´-i, whose rock is the Almighty. Num. 1. 8.
texts.92.2972: Zuzims, zu´-zims, sprouting, or restless. Gen. 14. 5.
